coordinates: Godot [X,Z,H], metres. Mesh source positions are Blender [X,-Z,H].
principle: Three unequal connected rock masses; toe and crown are independent. No new panels, no evenly repeated knobs, no continuous shelf or horizontal seam crossing the ramp.

protected.routes: Use current design.json all routes: lock vertices of ALL actual triangles intersecting full roadbed halfwidth+bench_margin (default .28). Fade additional .35m beyond this footprint. Do not let target section blend overwrite protected triangles.
protected.courts: Use current design.json all platforms and junction polygons, lock actual intersecting triangles and .15m margin. Leave actual stair landing heights unchanged.
protected.floors: Use live exact convex hulls of Town_Floor/Hut_Floor/TavernPorch; lock intersecting triangles and conservative .30m footprint margin. AABB coordinates below only preliminary guards.

protected.south_ramp: Full corridor through [12,34.8] [14,34.8] [16.5,35.1] [18.9,35.7] [20.2,36.3] [21.4,36.5] unchanged. Fade mass B by Z33.4; start mass C at Z37.8.

mass_A.label: Sea Breeze rear shoulder turning toward the hospital
mass_A.description: Restrained rear mass because the restaurant floor reaches X19.03. Crown turns diagonally from X22 to X20.7; avoid a new wall pressed against the rear building. Visible southern side should have one broad angular plane, north end blends into existing climbing route.
mass_A.caution: At Z26.8 protect the actual floor+margin: some target vertices must remain baseline, so use the next mass only after Z27.2. Preserve terrain behind the floor; do not lower support.

mass_B.label: Primary exposed hospital buttress and recessed southern bay
mass_B.description: Main visible improvement. A wide westward projection peaks around Z29, with a low debris apron and one oblique broad plane. At Z31.5 the toe returns inland while crown stays outward, making a genuinely different side-face. Avoid a sinusoidal series; use irregular stations and broad planar portions.

talus_patch.description: Continuous low foot debris integrated with the terrain, one lobe tapering into soil; no fence of repeated standalone boulders.

mass_B.caution: The row Z27.5 is only .74m beyond the southern floor AABB; protect exact floor-adjacent faces. Keep the intact upper road core: its western edge at Z30 is about X20.73, so profile reaches near-full road height before it. Rock/soil may meet the road shoulder directly; do not add a uniform green lip.

mass_C.label: Tavern rear broad wedge with lower southern shoulder
mass_C.description: Lower-weight secondary wedge, separated from B by the actual climbing passage. Its crest is farther inland at north and bends seaward toward south. Only one broad middle ledge near Z41..42, not a repeated stair profile.
mass_C.caution: Tavern floor reaches X16.17 at Z38..43; use exact floor hull and margin. Do not place loose debris into the narrow rear-side gap. The southern floor/props toward diner begin near Z46: fade back to baseline before Z45.2.

implementation_notes: These are proposed target sections, not sampled source coordinates. Parent should inspect monochrome silhouette and adapt after live protected-footprint clipping.

Interpolate the broad mass section locations with monotone/slope-limited curves, keep across-face segments mostly planar. Round only major transitions over about .15-.30m; do not smooth the whole face into the old S-profile.

Fade to immutable new-round baseline at both Z ends and outside each profile X extent, lock protected triangles before writing. If clipping creates a ridge, revise the section; never relax path/floor constraints to hide it.

Surface geometry accents should be sparse: two or three broad oblique fracture offsets, <=.08m normal relief, with locations chosen per mass. Main silhouette is in these section controls, not the accents.

Classify rock from actual intended mass faces, soil on apron/shoulder, grass on plausible top/pockets. Do not use slope alone to repaint every steep grass face grey, or preserve pixel green islands stranded in the new rock.
Road wear should remain within full fixed route/court. Vary .10-.30m soft irregular edge and small dirt intrusions into actual level verge, avoiding persistent parallel yellow/green strips.
Review normal gameplay plus town_civic_street and fishing_working_court first, then near shots. All form editing via owned live Blender MCP only.
